source_role: Previously used supplied singles development source; sparse automated source assessment, not human gold or an unseen test

protocol.sampling: Every 25th native frame from 434 through 684 inclusive; fixed before opening predictions
protocol.assessments: Two genuine fresh source-only sessions; originals sealed before comparison; source-only adjudication before cached predictions are opened
protocol.localization: All visible on-court persons; native display-pixel boxes; unknown/unlocalizable persons and incomplete frames retained
protocol.matching: Deterministic one-to-one maximum total IoU using only pairs with IoU >= 0.5; ties deterministic; no threshold selection
protocol.identity: Adjacent sampled source actors within one source view and uninterrupted cached camera/eligible scene context; unknown/missing cases break eligibility
protocol.limitations: court_view means a visible court image, not independently certified live play; sparse continuity cannot measure full-run switches or persistent named identities
